reason: A local DeepSeek Harness skill-management plugin for categorizing, tagging, grouping, browsing, and enabling or disabling agent skills through a settings panel and slash commands.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中对智能体技能进行分类、标记、集合整理、浏览筛选以及启用或停用管理的本地插件。
summaries.en: A local DeepSeek Harness plugin for categorizing, tagging, grouping, browsing, and enabling or disabling agent skills.

capabilities: Reads available agent skill metadata and descriptions
Writes category and tag metadata to writable SKILL.md frontmatter
Writes local collection data to a JSON file
Enables or disables skills by modifying invocation metadata
Provides a settings panel and slash commands for skill management
